history.summary: Plan completed and committed (6290014). It is cross-cutting, with six phases: KubeCoderDeploy promote handoff line, Ansible copy removal, DockerImages suite gating plus the 5-minute appear timeout, the Argo CD follow, failed-roll diagnosis, and KubeCoder roll-check docs. verification.json has 16 criteria covering R1-R6; R4's live proof is owed after the operator's next Promote-PRD run. Live checks turned three facts into phase constraints: the console masks the pin line's owner as ****, the compared revision leads the synced one, and resource health is not in the Application.

Criteria cover R1-R6 one-to-one and every Target resolves, but two findings block: once Argo has seen the commit, the roll wait has no bound, so an app whose health stays Progressing (e.g. dnsmasq-prd's StatefulSet) holds the tracker forever, which the operator should rule on; and the settled 'Done' ruling checks the compared revision, which P4 disproves in a later bullet instead of the ruling being edited.

All four r1 rulings and both blocking findings are applied (5cc378b). F1: the roll deadline and the report-only path for handoffs that pushed nothing shape P4 and P5, P1's promote line tells a fast-forward from a record-only re-run, and new criteria V17/V18 cover both. F2: P4 no longer restates the Done ruling. A1 widens P6 and V14; A2 declares python3-yaml in P3 (V19). V03 and V15 now require one stop that names every missing clone, the live check being DockerImages #2548's ten pin lines.
